name: Milton / Oakville; formerly Hamilton / Meadowvale Business Park
description: Two unrelated uses are documented: a Hamilton–Meadowvale commuter bus in 2009 and the Milton–Oakville service introduced in 2024 from 21A.

timeline.event: Route 22 links Hamilton GO with Meadowvale Business Park via Aldershot and Burlington’s Dundas / Highway 407 lot, one weekday trip each way.
Number 22 was introduced for the Milton–Oakville corridor formerly 21A.
The new timetable’s first weekday lists seven trips each way, generally two-hourly outside the morning.

gaps: The old Hamilton–Meadowvale route’s introduction and withdrawal dates are unknown.
